name: ants-nest
description: A local-first Cloudflare Tunnel desktop app and agent-friendly CLI
author: Bug The Debugger

scripts.dev:main: tsup src/main/index.ts src/main/preload.ts src/cli/index.ts src/cli/install-runner.ts src/core/expiry-worker.ts src/core/file-share-worker.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --external node:sqlite --watch --onSuccess "node scripts/start-electron.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && tsup src/main/index.ts src/main/preload.ts src/cli/index.ts src/cli/install-runner.ts src/core/expiry-worker.ts src/core/file-share-worker.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --external node:sqlite --sourcemap && node scripts/build-standalone-cli.mjs
scripts.package: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder && node scripts/prepare-release.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.install:cli: npm run build && node dist/cli/install-runner.cjs install
scripts.install:all: npm run package && node dist/cli/install-runner.cjs install-all
scripts.uninstall:cli: npm run build && node dist/cli/install-runner.cjs uninstall
scripts.uninstall:all: npm run build && node dist/cli/install-runner.cjs uninstall-all
